blocking_edges.behavior: hash -> synchronous sample_actions and device_get -> publish RPC -> controlled_step RPC -> recorder save npz/json -> video -> next inference; each 60ms simulated action waits whole chain
viewer event polling and driver.step share one worker main thread; during 15physics+capture no render event pump
native keyboard polls only key_down in after_render: a complete press/release inside blocked interval is never seen
full pose IK max_iterations150 per active moving arm synchronous on same UI thread
any ValueError or RuntimeError globally pauses; last right IK error0.314mm >0.25mm threshold explains final unresponsive state
npz write plus hashes/deepcopy/jsonl/summary scan+write every step; included in next control deadline
driver synchronously calls session.apply and session.capture
camera configured RT32samples/depth8 and actual three rawRGB per capture

limits: No per-stage runtime profiler existed in v3: 225ms non-inference residual cannot be attributed entirely to render or disk.
Recorded key timestamps are event-pump timestamps, not OS hardware timestamps: they do not directly measure physical key response.
Fresh current observation proposal policy is incompatible with16.7Hz wallclock while inference alone76ms; decoupling requires explicit reference semantics.
suggested_boundaries: Dedicated input capture with actual press/release queue and OS timestamps independent of render; no blocking inference or IK or disk on it.
Scene owner main thread serial physics/camera/viewport accesses; use incremental DLS IK budget, pump input/viewport before bounded physics slices; SAPIEN sharing threads without contract unsafe.
Policy process receives immutable obs_id/hash+policyversion+seed, returns actionplan bound to that obs. Separate bounded recorder process saves immutable transition snapshots.

Strict same-observation pair mode may remain slower. Smooth teleop mode must mark absent/stale proposals and never claim fresh pairs. Posthoc policy queries on exact saved observation can form separately labeled reference data, never online rejected candidates or counterfactual reward/successor.
Input release/Pause supersedes motion immediately with generation tokens; on single-arm IK fail hold that side with visible warning, no silent entire-system pause except global faults.
